_comment: Who counts as one provider, written down once, in a file neither language owns.
The provider identity is expressed twice and has to be: web/lib/providers.ts mints the
URL a reader visits, and src/afterward/providers.py counts the providers coverage.json
publishes, and neither can call the other. Two expressions of one rule are two things
that can drift, so this table is the thing they are both tested against -- web's
lib/providers.test.ts and tests/test_providers.py each read this file and assert every
row. A change to one implementation that this file does not sanction turns one suite red.
An empty slug means the name carries no identity: it is excluded from every count rather
than pooled with the other blanks, which would merge two anonymous filers into one.
The four colliding pairs are not invented. Three are the filings that made dataset-
2026-09-12 publish 584 providers on one page and 581 on another (#155); the Fresno pair
is the case web/lib/providers.ts was written for.
